newsitem.title: USA: Home Access to offer AIDS tests via Wal-Mart.
newsitem.headline: Home Access to offer AIDS tests via Wal-Mart.

text.p: Home Access Health Corp. said Thursday it signed a distribution agreement with Wal-Mart Stores Inc. to offer its HIV-1 test kits in the retailer's stores.
Wal-Mart, the nation's largest retail chain, plans to offer both the Home Access and Home Access Express test kits in all 50 states, Home Access said.
The kits allow for anonymous testing of blood for the virus that causes AIDS in the privacy of one's home. The Food and Drug Administration approved the product in 1996.
